# Verge — HTTP 402 Payment Gateway for AI Agents
> Verge is an HTTP 402 gateway and SDK. Pay-per-request APIs on Robinhood Chain (USDG) and 6 other rails.

## Gateway
- Website: https://vergesnowy.com
- App/Console: https://vergesnowy.com/app
- Docs: https://vergesnowy.com/docs
- Catalog API: https://vergesnowy.com/api/catalog
- Changelog: https://vergesnowy.com/changelog
- Trust: https://vergesnowy.com/trust

## Protocol
- x402 v2 compatible (PAYMENT-REQUIRED + PAYMENT-SIGNATURE headers)
- Legacy dialect: WWW-Authenticate: x402 + X-Pay-Tx / X-Pay-Nonce
- Facilitator: https://vergesnowy.com/api/facilitator
  - /supported — payment kinds
  - /verify — verify payment payload (read-only)
  - /settle — settle on-chain and commit nonce

## Payment Rails
- robinhood-mainnet — Robinhood Chain 4663, USDG (default)
- ethereum-mainnet — Ethereum 1, USDC
- base-mainnet — Base 8453, USDC
- arbitrum-mainnet — Arbitrum 42161, USDC
- polygon-mainnet — Polygon 137, USDC
- solana-mainnet — Solana, USDC
- sui-mainnet — Sui, USDC

## Live Endpoints (pay-per-call)
- GET https://vergesnowy.com/api/demo — 0.001 USDG demo
- GET https://vergesnowy.com/x/<slug> — hosted marketplace endpoints

## Buyer SDK
- npm install @vergex402/fetch — payAndFetch() wrapper
- npm install @vergex402/express — Express middleware
- npm install @vergex402/hono — Hono adapter

## MCP Server (for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor agents)
- POST https://vergesnowy.com/api/mcp
- Tools: inspect_endpoint, list_marketplace, create_invoice, get_reputation

## Quick Start (agent payment)
```typescript
import { payAndFetch, createSignerFromKey } from '@vergex402/fetch';
const signer = createSignerFromKey(process.env.AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY, 4663);
const data = await payAndFetch('https://vergesnowy.com/api/demo', { signer });
```

## Marketplace
- GET https://vergesnowy.com/api/marketplace — public endpoint directory
- Templates: random-joke, daily-quote, crypto-price, news, alerts, whale-alerts, signals, gas-prices, fear-greed, trending-tokens, robinhood-pools, rh-token-prices
